Everything we needed from snorkels, boogie boards and beach chairs!  Great location and the view was amazing!!!

Bree, our host was fantastic with prompt responses to any questions and any time. The condo was clean, has all the amenities we needed a has a washer and dryer in the unit which was very convenient. The neighbors were fairly quiet. We truly enjoyed our stay. We will stay here again on our next visit.

We had everything we needed and more. Will definitely recommend Bree’s place to others!

You get exactly what is in the pictures.

Truly incredible balcony and view. We saw at least a dozen turtles right off the shore over the week. Everything you need is provided for the kitchen and beach. Walkable to some food. Bree was a great host. Awesome binder full of local tips.

Great spot! Thank you, Jill!
